concepts.title: Exit behaviour

survey_note.differs: ruff classifies a function body syntactically (always raises, implicit return and so on) and does not know NoReturn callees. pyrefly infers the type of falling off the end (Never means unreachable) per function, not per path, depending on `infer-return-types`. ty records a non-terminal-call predicate per call statement that resolves false only for annotated Never/NoReturn callees, since unannotated returns are Unknown.
